items.summary: All five broken relative links confirmed against disk and repaired. Verified by resolving every relative link in the domain: before, 601 links with 5 unresolvable; after, 601 links with 0 unresolvable. Three were wrong-depth intra-domain sibling links (`../../07.0N-` from a leaf file resolves to the ideation root, not the domain root); two pointed at pre-rename domain directory names (`24-trust-safety`, `20-fanbase-community`) that no longer exist on disk.
canonicalSource: Path convention (leaf files at ideation/07-.../07.0N-.../file.md): intra-domain sibling = `../07.0N-name/` (129 correct uses in the domain vs the 3 broken 2x-dotdot uses); cross-domain = `../../NN-name/` (164 correct uses).

Display-name convention inside domain 07: '**24 Trust, Safety & Disputes**' (14 uses, incl. 07.03.01-contributor-roster-role-assignment.md:234 — the line directly above one of the defects, in the same file) and '**20 Fanbase & Direct-to-Fan**' (07.03.02-contributor-invitation-scoped-onboarding.md).

Wrong depth — `../..` from a leaf file lands at the ideation root. Sibling features take one `..`.

items.semanticImpact: None. Every repaired link already named the correct target symbolically (07.07.02, 07.06.01, 07.08.03, domain 24, domain 20) and the surrounding prose was untouched — only the href and two stale domain titles moved. No decision, threshold, or product behaviour changed.

verification.method: Resolved all relative markdown links under the domain against the filesystem, before and after.
verification.note: All five edits are on prose bullet lines; no markdown table column counts were affected.

crossDomainNotes: The two rename misses (24-trust-safety -> 24-trust-safety-disputes, 20-fanbase-community -> 20-fanbase-direct-to-fan) are almost certainly not confined to domain 07 — a directory rename that left stragglers here likely left them in other domains too. A tree-wide sweep for `](../../24-trust-safety/` and `](../../20-fanbase-community/` (and for any other pre-rename domain slug) is worth running outside this shard. Not actioned: those files are owned by other agents.

The wrong-depth pattern (`../../07.0N-` used from a leaf file, where the correct form is `../07.0N-`) is a generic authoring slip, not a 07-specific one. Every domain with the same three-level layout can carry it. A cheap tree-wide guard is to resolve every relative link against disk in CI — the check that found and confirmed all five here ran in well under a second over 601 links.
